description: The study presents indicators for comparing the flexibility of district heating and cooling systems, combining demand-side metrics, storage dynamics and system performance. The authors apply them to a Norwegian case under policy and climate scenarios. The provider is Riedl, Leopold; Zwickl-Bernhard, Sebastian; Kranzl, Lukas; Kauko, Hanne; Schifflechner, Christopher. Coverage: Coverage is one Norwegian case study. Its exact location, time horizon and numerical resolution are not specified in the record abstract. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. Access is marked open. Limitations: The metadata describe the authors’ work; they do not independently establish accuracy, completeness or reproducibility. For simulation it offers an assessment method for comparing district-energy flexibility results. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
